name: Should I replace all flooring or just specific rooms before selling?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace all flooring or just specific rooms before selling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to replace all or some flooring depends on its condition and consistency. If only a few rooms have severely damaged or outdated flooring, focusing on those areas might suffice. However, a consistent flooring type throughout main living areas can create a more cohesive and spacious feel, which appeals to buyers. Avoid mixing too many different flooring types, as this can make a home feel disjointed. Prioritize high-traffic areas and rooms where flooring is most visible or damaged.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace flooring in all main living areas for a cohesive look, or target severely damaged rooms. Avoid mixing too many types to maintain a spacious feel.
